step_by_step_reasoning: The whiteboard shows a cryptocurrency trading architecture managed by GSR. GSR (UserCompanyDeveloper) connects to EC2 clusters which manage trading and exchange connections. EC2 connects to external Exchanges (ThirdParty) via AWS Direct Connect (DX) and AWS PrivateLink. For storage and data persistence, EC2 connects to ElastiCache, Amazon Aurora, and Amazon EFS. EFS syncs market data to Amazon S3 using AWS DataSync. S3 interacts bidirectionally with AWS Batch for running simulation workloads. GSR also interacts directly with S3 and EC2.
